title: TEC Working Groups Weekly Update, Oct 25

posts.cooked:
Monday, October 24, 2021

Hello ! Here are the Working Group updates from the last week. If you feel like you’re missing out, check out the calendar and join us in real time during any of our many calls.

This week’s Spotlight: Deep Work

Stewards

  • This week marks the rise of our 20th Sprint, with more than 40 weeks of working pace under our wings, and a nest of >1.5M wxDAI
  • From these funds, The Initial Buy-in forum post proposes that we use 250K wxDAI to buy into our own bonding curve, judoing our Commons Upgrade initialization into an arbitrage event
  • By the way, throwback to our values so we never forget what we stand for
  • Forum Highlight: As always, check out our TEC Timeline here. If you’re feeling lost, lean on the visual explainers from our TEC Handbook here. If you see something in the community that you’d like to address, or some work that needs to be done, open an issue on one of our ZenHub’s workspace boards here

Gravity

  • The 5th session of our 2nd Graviton Training concerned Alternative Dispute Resolution and was hosted by Lorelei Loie
  • Our 6th session will center around Decolonization and will be hosted by Durgadas (On Tuesday Oct. 26)
  • Once again, our Nonviolent Communication (NVC) bookclub took place on Thursday in the DAO Bookclub server; we are currently on Chapter 4 of Nonviolent Communication: A Language of Life by Marshall B. Rosenberg
  • Last week we launched a new GitHub repo to coordinate our issues
  • Gravity’s ethos is to continue fostering competent conflict management for us personally, and for our community collectively
  • Forum Highlight: 2nd Graviton Training Study Plan

Commons Swarm

  • Check out our new EVM-Crispr front-end: it allows non-developers to craft more intricate DAO proposals; a critical new piece of TE infrastructure
  • To prevent website downtime, Commons Stack has created several (redundant) sites for the management of our DAO: here, here, and here

Soft Gov

  • Our Rewards System Task Force has been at it for weeks now, updating our Praise framework. Their next sync call is Thursday Oct. 28th at 16:00 CET in our Community Hall VC
  • The advising, voting, and structural decision-making of our Commons is done differently depending on its scale of impact: check how we’re conceptualizing the process visually here
  • Forum Highlight: We now have a Peer to Peer Feedback form so feel free to leave us some feedback

Communitas

  • We are still working on improving the onboarding journey, making it more accessible for everyone. If you have any feedback on how we can improve, contact @eduardovegap on Discord
  • Wanna contribute? Check our Communitas WG Funding Proposal and comment on ways to co-create it together
  • Forum Highlight: Our Orientation Call is Wednesdays at 18:00 CET on the Community Hall VC; and our TEC Lounge is Fridays at 17:00 CET also on the Community Hall VC

0mega

  • As a relevant reminder, make sure to check our manifesto
  • Started a series on Ethical Decision-making frameworks with Mount Manu’s presentation on the Capability Approach as a framework to evaluate an individual’s freedom to pursue well-being
  • Forum Highlight: Our WG sync calls are now weekly: the next one will be this Wednesday Oct. 20th at 20:00 CET in the Omega VC

Labs

  • Currently focusing on Rewards System Research: join us Fridays at 9am PST/6pm CEST (at our TEC Discord server)
  • For our Praise Evolution Taskforce: join us Thursdays at 7am PST/4pm CEST (at our TEC Discord server)
  • For our DAO2DAO Models Workshops: join us Wednesdays at 9am PST/6pm CEST (at the PrimeDAO Discord server)
  • For the Tokenspice Development Workshop: join us Mondays at 8am PST/5pm CEST (at the Token Engineering Academy Discord Server)
  • Forum Highlight: Solidity study group hosted by @metaverde: Nov 18 - Feb 24th

Comms

  • We will soon rebrand to T.E.A.M. (Token Engineering Amplify Messengers)
  • Our Creative Onboarding campaign continues and we are now looking for project managers, social media managers, graphic designers, and animators for contributors
  • Working on a framework for bounties and Comms-related project management
  • Post-Commons Upgrade manifesto will soon be unveiled!
    • Forum Highlight: DM @Mount Manu#3530 on Discord if you’d like to join this WG but don’t know where to start!

Transparency

  • Ongoing discussion about updating our audit process, incorporating analytics, and creating a transparency report for all WGs (as opposed to doing individual reporting)
  • Forum Highlight: Our WG’s bi-weekly sync calls are on Mondays at 15:00 CET

Legal

  • Finished the current draft of terms and conditions for the ABC
  • Forum Highlight: Join us every other Friday at 16:00 CET for a chance to contribute and learn more about the ABC’s legal framework

Params

  • Ongoing design validation of the Commons Configuration Dashboard (CCD)
  • Finished beta version testing of the CCD this weekend
  • Play with our dashboard here
  • Forum Highlight: Don’t hesitate to open an issue on ZenHub if you have suggestions on how to improve our CCD

Thanks for reading the update this week! Be sure to check out the calendar to join us on a call!
